C-20.Name: Relative-path autocomplete for markdown links (matrix P1, small)
C-20.IntentSummary: Complete relative link destinations by suggestion: a muya LinkPathPicker float (QuickInsert pattern) triggers while typing inside `](…`, fed by a generalized ASK_FOR_FILE_PATH store action (readdir + dir-part/prefix, .md+dirs flavor; image flavor delegates unchanged), inserting the chosen path inline and closing on files while directories continue browsing.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ASK_FOR_FILE_PATH(src, { exts, includeDirs }) with the existing dir-part/prefix/50-cap logic; ASK_FOR_IMAGE_AUTO_PATH becomes a thin delegate (image exts) — image behavior byte-identical; unit tables for both flavors.

QuickInsert-pattern input listener detects a cursor inside an inline link destination (trigger on the raw text up to the cursor matching /\]\([^)]*$/); dispatches muya-link-picker with { reference, list, cb }; BaseScrollFloat rendering mirroring ImagePathPicker; keyboard nav (Up/Down/Enter/Tab/Esc) does not leak into the document; directories continue, files close.

Verification.Command: npm run test:coverage; npx playwright test tests/e2e/link-autocomplete.spec.ts

Review-1.Angle: correctness (trigger regex false positives inside code spans/images, keyboard event leakage, cursor/DOM reference stability across renders)

Review-2.Angle: security (readdir surface stays local+read-only, no path escape beyond typed subpaths), GRACE consistency, image-autocomplete parity

Evidence.Gates: Unit: file-path-autocomplete 6/6 (incl. camelCase stat shape — review blocker — and the subtree clamp); scoped 273 green; full e2e 68 passed (link-autocomplete 2/2: prefix filter + Enter insert + ')' completion; directory continuation into sub/ + deep.md + Esc close + image-destination rejection); isolated HEAD+patch full vitest 228 files / 3105 tests green (thresholds pass); cargo untouched; grace lint zero findings on changed files.

Review-2 (security/contracts): NEEDS-FIXES round-1 — 2 MAJOR (readdir surface allowed absolute/ ..-escapes contradicting the spec constraint; untracked index.css would break the build), 1 MAJOR (scenario-32 overclaim), MINORs (store CHANGE_SUMMARY, plugin LINKS anchor, plan scope/regex drift), NITs (front-matter surface, image flavor).
